newsSince: +3.5% since prior, +8.6% YTD. The Nestlé Waters carve-out auction narrowed materially since Jun 9: PAI Partners and KKR both exited, leaving only Clayton Dubilier & Rice and Platinum Equity bidding for a ~50% stake in the ~EUR5bn water unit. CEO Navratil reiterated the broader portfolio reset (coffee/petcare/nutrition focus, possible full Waters exit). Thinner buyer pool modestly weakens divestiture price tension but is not core to the consumption-demand thesis.
